title: Days Between
prompt: Using datetime.date, print the number of days between 2026-01-01 and 2026-09-13 (one line, just the number; subtracting dates gives a timedelta with .days).

tests.name: prints day count
tests.code:
assert printed[0] == "255", f"got {printed}"
assert "date" in code, "use datetime.date"
tests.hint: from datetime import date / d = date(2026, 9, 13) - date(2026, 1, 1) / print(d.days)
